title: Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo on Quantum Hardware via Unitary Dilation
summary: We present near-term quantum algorithms for auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC), viewed as imaginary-time projection for ground-state calculation as an ensemble of one-body propagators driven by stochastic fields $Ω$. Starting from the Feynman-Kac formula, we convert each trajectory into a sequence of piecewise-constant one-body generators using stochastic Magnus expansions up to second order, and embed the resulting nonunitary slices into unitaries with a small ancilla overhead.
